summary.oneLiner: Mumbai Zaveri Bazar based B2B wholesaler of hand-crafted 22-karat and 18-karat gold jewellery, operating an asset-light model in which all production is outsourced to Karigars through Jobworkers.
summary.business: The Company is engaged in the business of hand-crafted gold jewellery and provides customisation services to its clients, depending on third-party jobworkers for production and manufacturing of products; it does not manufacture any jewellery in-house. It acts as principal contractor, managing design, material sourcing and the finished jewellery making process, and also provides custom job work services where clients supply bullion along with specific design requirements.
